# AstroPrecise

> AstroPrecise is a privacy-first astrology site built around calculated sky positions, clear evidence and reflective interpretation. Birth-chart calculations run in the browser. A place-name search contacts Open-Meteo only to resolve coordinates.

AstroPrecise is available at https://astroprecise.app/. Astronomy and astrological interpretation are labelled separately. Astrology is presented as a cultural language for reflection and entertainment, not scientific fact, advice or prediction.

## Launch routes

- [Observatory](https://astroprecise.app/): The single general-purpose 3D solar-system model, with named worlds, live time and an Earth-to-Galaxy scale journey
- [12 August 2026 Eclipse](https://astroprecise.app/eclipse.html): Dedicated 3D Sun–Moon–Earth alignment, viewing guide, safety links and a private chart-contact tool
- [Birth Chart](https://astroprecise.app/chart.html): Free browser-calculated natal chart with time-dependent features withheld when birth time is unknown
- [Events](https://astroprecise.app/sky-events.html): Live ledger of verified sky events, including the next eclipse and meteor notes
- [Shop](https://astroprecise.app/shop.html): Free eclipse field guide and the £7 Your Eclipse Edition after a chart contact; no other SKUs are for sale
- [Published Reading Sample](https://astroprecise.app/sample-reading.html): A complete thirteen-page sample, available before any future purchase
- [Verify a Plate](https://astroprecise.app/verify.html): Recompute the published sample fingerprint against the public register
